meetings.title: 10th Meeting 2024
meetings.summary: The agenda for today’s meeting was to review the Urban Development Bill. Based on the comments received on the bill, the Attorney General's Office proposed the following changes: · A total of seven sections of the Bill (section 9 (a) (1); section 9 (b); section 9 (f); section 10 (c); section 13 (a); section 13 (b); section 14 (a); section 32 (a); section 37(b); and section 51(l)) were amended; and · An additional provision was incorporated after section 14(g) of the bill. Each amendment was put to a separate vote. Following this, the Committee Chairperson proposed the passage of the entire bill, including all amendments made by the committee. This proposal was unanimously passed by all members present. Details of how members voted on each proposal can be found in the "Votes" section below.

meetings.title: 9th Meeting 2024
meetings.summary: In this meeting, the committee deliberated on extending the deadline for the 'Urban Development Bill'. Hoarafushi Constituency Member Ali Moosa proposed and North Thinadhoo Constituency Member Saudulla Hilmy seconded to extend the deadline for the bill to 25 th November 2024. The proposal was passed unanimously by the Committee members present. The committee then discussed the next steps for further reviewing the Urban Development Bill. Following the discussions, Ali Moosa, the Member for Hoarafushi Constituency, proposed a motion to forward the comments received from the Ministry of Housing and Urban Development to the Attorney General's Office for their review. The motion was seconded by Ibrahim Mohamed, the Member for North Mahchangolhi Constituency. The proposal was passed unanimously by the Committee members present.

meetings.title: 7th Meeting 2024
meetings.summary: The agenda for this meeting was to review the Urban Development Bill. As the deadline for the bill had already passed, the Committee discussed the possibility of extending it to allow more time for review. When the floor was open for proposals, the Committee was presented with two proposals for the extension. The first proposal was made by Thoddoo Constituency Member Hussain Sameer to extend the bill's deadline by one month. This was seconded by Keyodhoo Constituency Member Mohamed Niushad. The purpose to extend the deadline was stated to allow the Committee to engage with key stakeholders, including Atoll Councils, Island Councils, NGOs and other CSOs. The proposal was not passed as it did not receive the required number of votes to pass. The second proposal, regarding the extension of the deadline, was submitted by Hoarafushi Constituency Member Ali Moosa. He proposed extending the deadline for the bill to 7th November 2024, and the proposal was seconded by Central Machchangolhi Constituency Member Ahmed Xamyr. This proposal was passed by the majority of the members present. Following this, the Committee further discussed how to proceed with the bill review. Central Machchangolhi Constituency Member Ahmed Xamyr proposed to schedule a meeting next week, allowing committee members time to evaluate the comments sent by the public. This proposal was seconded by North Henveyru Constituency Member Ahmed Aifan. This proposal was passed by the majority of the members present.

meetings.title: 4th Meeting 2024
meetings.summary: In this meeting, the Committee first reviewed the Sections (Section 4; Section 6 (b) (1); Section 13 (g), (i) and (j); and Section 25 (e)) of the Infrastructure Development and Planning bill that were not passed in the second meeting of the joint Committee. Central Mahchangolhi Member Ahmed Xamyr proposed, and North Mahchangolhi Constituency Member Ibrahim Mohamed seconded to pass the provisions as proposed in the bill without any amendment. The Committee unanimously passed Section 4; Section 6 (b) (1); Section 13 (g), (i) and (j); and Section 25 (e) with no changes. The Committee then passed the Infrastructure Development and Planning bill. Central Mahchangolhi Member Ahmed Xamyr proposed and North Henveyru Constituency Member Ahmed Aifan seconded to pass the bill as reviewed by the Committee. The Committee unanimously passed the Infrastructure Development and Planning bill. After that the Committee passed the Bill on Amendment to the Decentralization Act (Act No: 7/2010). North Henveyru Constituency Member Ahmed Aifan proposed, and Kudahuvadhoo Constituency Member Hussen Hameedh seconded the proposal. The Committee unanimously passed the Bill on Amendment to Decentralization Act.

meetings.title: 2nd Meeting 2024
meetings.summary: In today’s meeting, the agenda was to review the two bills submitted to the Committee. First the committee reviewed the Infrastructure Development and Planning Bill. After reviewing all the provisions of bill, North Henveyru Constituency Member Ahmed Aifan proposed and Central Mahchangolhi Member Ahmed Xamyr seconded to pass the provisions from Section 1 of the bill to Section 27. The proposal also included to schedule the passing of the following provisions of the bill to another meeting: · Section 4; · Section 6 (b) (1); · Section 13 (g), (i) and (j); and · Section 25 (e). The Committee unanimously passed Infrastructure Development and Planning Bill from section 1 to 27, excluding the parked sections. After that, the committee further reviewed the bill. North Henveyru Constituency Member Ahmed Aifan proposed to pass provisions of the bill from Section 28 to Section 49. This proposal was seconded by Nilandhoo Constituency Member Fathimath Sauda. The Committee unanimously passed Infrastructure Development and Planning Bill from sections 28 to 49. Next on the agenda was reviewing the Bill of Amendment to the Decentralization Act (Act No: 7/2010). After reviewing the bill, North Henveyru Constituency Member Ahmed Aifan proposed to pass the bill. This proposal was seconded by Central Mahchangolhi Member Ahmed Xamyr. The Committee unanimously passed the Amendment Bill on Decentralization Act (Act No: 7/2010).

meetings.title: 1st Meeting 2024
meetings.summary: The first item on the agenda for today's meeting was to elect the Chairperson and the Deputy Chairperson of the Committee. Director, Legal Affairs, Uza. Afzaal Abdul Sattar facilitated the election of the Chairperson and the Deputy Chairperson of the Committee. North Mahchangolhi Constituency Member Ibrahim Muhammad proposed to elect South Feydhoo Constituency Member Ibrahim Didi as the Committee’s chair. This was seconded by North Henveyru Constituency Member Ahmed Aifan. The Committee unanimously decided to elect South Feydhoo Constituency Member Ibrahim Didi as the Chair of the Committee. For the Deputy Chair of the Committee, North Henveyru Constituency Member Ahmed Aifan proposed, and Kudahuvadhoo Constituency Member Hussain Hameed seconded the name of Central Mahchangolhi Constituency Member Ahmed Xamyr. The Committee unanimously decided to elect Mahchangolhi Constituency Member Ahmed Xamyr’s as the Deputy Chair. The Committee then decided on the working quorum of the Committee. Thoddoo Constituency Member Hussain Sameer proposed 12 members as the working quorum, and Mahchangolhi Constituency Member Ahmed Xamyr seconded that proposal. The Committee unanimously decided on the Committee Working Quorum as 12 members. Next, the Committee decided on the voting quorum of the committee. Thoddoo Constituency Member Hussain Sameer proposed 12 members as the voting quorum, and this was seconded by Mahchangolhi Constituency Member Ahmed Xamyr. The Committee unanimously passed the voting quorum of the Committee to be 12 Members. After that, the Committee proceeded to set deadlines for the two bills (Amendment Bill to the Decentralization Act (7/2010) and Infrastructure Development and Planning Bill) sent to the Committee. Thoddoo Constituency Member Hussain Sameer proposed to set the deadline as 20th August 2024. This proposal was seconded by Mahchangolhi Constituency Member Ahmed Xamyr. The Committee unanimously decided to set the deadline as 20th August 2024 for the two bills. Lastly, Keyodhoo Constituency Member Mohamed Niushad proposed that the two bills to be opened for public comments until 18th August 2024. This proposal was seconded by Mahchangolhi Constituency Member Ahmed Xamyr. The Committee unanimously passed the decision.
